answer: Anchor every epoch claim to a sequential delay puzzle bound to the identity's key: a verifiable delay function that takes minutes of real, non-parallelizable computation before an answer can be submitted. A lone agent climbs that summit once per epoch and pays a few minutes. A farm with a thousand fakes must climb it a thousand times in sequence, and no amount of extra machines shortens a single climb — the umber wall of time itself becomes the cost, turning scale into a calendar, not a profit.
